{{Quote|That's really unusual, Princess Leia. I think I see a Huttian spaceship.|[[Ken]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Zorba the Hutt's Revenge">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>}}
A certain type of bell-shaped '''space yacht''' was used by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] at some point before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Those [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] had big entrance hatches, large enough for a masive Hutt to get in or out. The Huttese criminal [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] owned one, which he had christened the ''[[Zorba Express]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
That class of bell-shaped yacht only appeared in ''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]'' and ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', the third and fifth installements of the so-called [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] book series. In those novels, it was only referred to as a "Huttian spaceship," but a [[Wizards of the Coast]] online article called ''[[Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!]]'' established the ''Zorba Express'' was an "ancient star yacht."
